name: htop
summary: Interactive host process viewer and system monitor
description: htop is a cross-platform interactive process viewer. Inside Clipak, it accesses the host PID namespace, host cgroups, CPU performance stats, and memory allocations without container isolation overhead.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined visibility of host PID hierarchy, /proc process descriptors, host cgroups, and sysfs hardware counters

steps.name: bundle-htop
steps.command:
mkdir -p "${DESTDIR}/bin" "${DESTDIR}/share"
cp -a /usr/bin/htop "${DESTDIR}/bin/htop"
chmod +x "${DESTDIR}/bin/htop"
if [ -d /usr/share/htop ]; then cp -a /usr/share/htop "${DESTDIR}/share/"; fi
